description: Word-level Bare Act footnotes for Learn Read/Card hover (memorized unit.text stays plain). schema 1.1 adds structured tip content + shared notes for nested refs. schema 1.2 adds optional surfaces for Browse-only diglot tips.

article-55-2026-amendment.note: Subs. by the Constitution (Eighty-fourth Amendment) Act, 2001, s. 2, for "2000" (w.e.f. 21-2-2002).

article-54.note: "State" includes the National Capital Territory of Delhi and the Union territory of *Puducherry.

article-124-clause-1.note: Now “thirty-three” vide the Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Act, 2019 (37 of 2019), s. 2 (w.e.f. 9-8-2019).

article-326.note: Subs. by the Constitution (Sixty-first Amendment) Act, 1988, s. 2, for "twenty-one years" (w.e.f. 28-3-1989).

content.value: In this article, the expression "population" means the population as ascertained at the last preceding census of which the relevant figures have been published: Provided that the reference in this Explanation to the last preceding census of which the relevant figures have been published shall, until the relevant figures for the first census taken after the year
have been published, be construed as a reference to the 1971 census.

article-288-clause-1.target: law of a State in force
article-288-clause-1.note: Explanation.—The expression 'law of a State in force' in this clause shall include a law of a State passed or made before the commencement of this Constitution and not previously repealed, notwithstanding that it or parts of it may not be then in operation either at all or in particular areas.

article-264.note: The diglot Bare Act closes article 264 with a trailing amendment bracket (']'). This app prints the operative definition without that marker.

article-267-clause-2.note: The diglot Bare Act shows omitted Rajpramukh wording as 'Governor 1 ***'. This app prints 'Governor' only.

article-268-clause-1.note: The diglot Bare Act shows omitted excise-on-medicinal-and-toilet-preparations wording as '2***' after 'stamp duties'. This app prints the current Bare Act without that marker.

article-268a.note: Article 268A was omitted by the Constitution (One Hundred and First Amendment) Act, 2016, s. 7 (w.e.f. 16-9-2016). The Bare Act prints “[Omitted.]”.

article-269-clause-1.note: Article 269A (GST on inter-State supplies) was inserted by the Constitution (One Hundred and First Amendment) Act, 2016. Diglot amendment brackets around clause (1) are stripped in this app.

article-271.target: except the goods and services tax under article 246A
article-271.note: The GST carve-out was inserted by the Constitution (One Hundred and First Amendment) Act, 2016. Diglot brackets are stripped; article 272’s omission note is not glued here.

article-272.note: Article 272 was omitted by the Constitution (Eightieth Amendment) Act, 2000, s. 4 (w.e.f. 9-6-2000). The Bare Act prints “[Omitted.]”.

article-278.note: Article 278 was omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956, s. 29 and Sch. (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). The Bare Act prints “[Omitted.]”.

article-283-clause-2.note: The diglot Bare Act shows omitted Rajpramukh wording as 'Governor 1 ***'. This app prints 'Governor' only.

article-286-clause-1.target: supply of goods or of services or both
article-286-clause-1.note: Substituted by the Constitution (One Hundred and First Amendment) Act, 2016, for the earlier “sale or purchase of goods” formulation. Diglot superscripts are stripped.

article-290a.note: Article 290A was inserted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956, s. 19; “Tamil Nadu” substituted for “Madras” by the Madras State (Alteration of Name) Act, 1968.

article-291.note: Article 291 was omitted by the Constitution (Twenty-sixth Amendment) Act, 1971, s. 2. The Bare Act prints “[Omitted.]”.

article-299-clause-1.note: The diglot Bare Act shows omitted Rajpramukh wording as 'Governor 1 ***'. This app prints 'Governor' only.

article-300a.note: Article 300A was inserted by the Constitution (Forty-fourth Amendment) Act, 1978, s. 34. The diglot trailing “]” is stripped.

article-304.note: Inserted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956, s. 29 and Sch. Diglot brackets/superscripts are stripped; the operative words remain.

article-306.note: Article 306 was omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956, s. 29 and Sch. The Bare Act prints “[Omitted.]”.

article-308.note: The diglot Bare Act marks the J&K carve-out with amendment brackets ('1 […]'). This app keeps the operative Bare Act wording without those markers.

article-310-clause-2.note: The diglot Bare Act shows omitted Rajpramukh wording as 'Governor 2 ***'. This app prints 'Governor' only.

article-312-clause-1.target: Chapter VI of Part VI or Part XI
article-312-clause-1.note: Substituted/inserted language from the Forty-second Amendment (all-India judicial service). Diglot brackets are stripped; article 312A is not glued after clause (4).
